name: uv (Python)
description: Installs the uv Python package and interpreter manager as a single static binary.

python.description: Installs this CPython at build as the default (adds python/python3 to PATH). Empty installs no interpreter, leaving uv to use an available Python or download one on demand.

stateDir.description: If set, exports uv's cache, tools, and managed-Python dirs to this path (persist them by mounting a volume there) and sets UV_LINK_MODE=copy. Empty leaves uv's ~/.local defaults.
